critical.issue: site_defaults.py barsaat block has NO menu.items array. The 10-course Barsaat menu (Khicchu, Panko Bombay Duck → Dakor Na Gota, Thepla Tacos → Jackfruit, Dal Bhaat → Mushroom, Sev Ussal → Cholar Dal Miso, etc.) only existed in the live published site_content document and was never added to defaults. ANY admin click of 'Reset to defaults' (or this iteration's reset test) wipes barsaat.menu.items to []. This was triggered during testing and the live Barsaat menu is now EMPTY — /api/site-content returns barsaat.menu = {} and the public /supper-club/barsaat/menu page will show the WIP placeholder again (the exact bug the user originally complained about).

rca of the issue: Root cause of the menu wipe: backend/site_defaults.py defines barsaat without a menu key. site_content reset overwrites both draft and published with deepcopy(DEFAULT_CONTENT). The Barsaat 10-item menu was added live via PUT /admin/site-content/draft + publish but never back-ported to defaults. When test_site_content_reset_restores_defaults runs the reset endpoint, the menu is wiped. Mitigation already applied to tests: snapshot original published+draft and PUT-back after reset (so the test alone no longer destroys data going forward). But the underlying defaults gap remains — and right now the live DB still has barsaat.menu.items=[] because the FIRST test run before the hardening had already wiped it. Main agent must (a) populate site_defaults.py with the 10 Barsaat items + alt_dish/alt_note, then (b) run a one-time reset/seed to repopulate the live document.
